title: Hull & deck
subs: Re-coring the starboard deck, the deck-to-hull joint, stanchions and drains.
Fourteen weeks of sanding, priming and painting, new hatches and companionway.
Opening ports, fixed windows, adhesion tests and the second set of ports.
New windlass mount, rebuilt chain locker, bow roller and anchor rode.
Blisters, barrier coat, topside paint, thru-hulls and her name.

title: Rig & sails
subs: Mast top survey, mast steps, step-down, Nyalic coating and tuning.
New chainplates, the forestay failure and the switch to Dyneema.
Sail pack, the new mainsail, boom, reefing, winches, bimini and dodger.

title: Engine & mechanical
subs: Yanmar 2QM20: haul-out, new mounts, fresh water cooling, manual starter, bilge.
Opening the leaking integral tank and rebuilding it with fuel-resistant epoxy.
Quadrant, rudder sensor, pedestal guard, rudder drop and dripless seal.

title: Electrical & electronics
subs: New wiring, electric panel, batteries, inverter, shore power and ELCI.
OpenPlotter, autopilot, wind instrument, AIS, radar and the NavPod.
Home-made controllers: KhatkaPi, LPG, shower, dry bilge, tank fill, lights.

title: Interior & comfort
subs: Bulkheads, headliner, cabinets, trim and many coats of varnish.
New cabin sole, hand-sewn cushions, cabin and chart tables.
New galley base and countertop, and the refrigerator built from scratch.
Shower walls, head cabinet, toilet and the shower that was never built.
Osmosis in the tanks, new plumbing, pumps and the water heater.
Webasto unit, raw water pump trouble, ducts and teak vents.

title: The journey
subs: How Vira found me, what she looked like and what was wrong.
Leaving drought-struck Lake Travis for Kemah, and nine days on the hard.
Sailing days, people, weather and life around the boat.
Half-year reports and lists of what was done.
